cards.name: Test Commander
cards.oracle_text: Flying

cards.name: Sol Ring
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {C}{C}.

cards.name: Arcane Signet
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander’s color identity.

cards.name: Blood Artist
cards.oracle_text: Whenever Blood Artist or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Viscera Seer
cards.oracle_text: Sacrifice a creature: Scry 1.

cards.name: Reanimate
cards.oracle_text: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. You lose life equal to its mana value.

cards.name: Eternal Witness
cards.oracle_text: When Eternal Witness enters, return target card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Stitcher's Supplier
cards.oracle_text: When Stitcher's Supplier enters or dies, mill three cards.

cards.name: Animate Dead
cards.oracle_text: Enchant creature card in a graveyard.

cards.name: Living Death
cards.oracle_text: Each player exiles all creature cards from their graveyard, then sacrifices all creatures they control, then puts all cards they exiled this way onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Soul-Guide Lantern
cards.oracle_text: When Soul-Guide Lantern enters, exile target card from a graveyard. {T}, Sacrifice Soul-Guide Lantern: Exile each opponent’s graveyard. {1}, {T}, Sacrifice Soul-Guide Lantern: Draw a card.

cards.name: Bojuka Bog
cards.oracle_text: Bojuka Bog enters tapped. When Bojuka Bog enters, exile target player’s graveyard. {T}: Add {B}.

cards.name: Scavenger Grounds
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {C}. {2}, {T}, Sacrifice a Desert: Exile all cards from all graveyards.

cards.name: Scavenging Ooze
cards.oracle_text: {G}: Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, put a +1/+1 counter on Scavenging Ooze and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Swords to Plowshares
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature. Its controller gains life equal to its power.

cards.name: Beast Within
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target permanent. Its controller creates a 3/3 green Beast creature token.

cards.name: Generous Gift
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target permanent. Its controller creates a 3/3 white Elephant creature token.

cards.name: Counterspell
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell.

cards.name: Forest
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {G}.

cards.name: Mystic Engine
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, draw a card.

cards.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
cards.oracle_text: Lifelink

cards.name: Walking Ballista
cards.oracle_text: Walking Ballista enters with X +1/+1 counters.

cards.name: Negate
cards.oracle_text: Counter target noncreature spell.

matchup.note: Observed coverage index, not win probability. Partial lists cannot establish overall readiness; 0–100 bounds acknowledge unknown threats and answers.
matchup.formula: 100 × (0.85 × Σ(T² × profile × min(1,C/max(T,1))) / Σ(T² × profile) + 0.15 × pressure)

recommendations.message: No changes justified by observed coverage. Unknown cards may change this conclusion.
